imperial_aramaic.object: Berlin Pap. Ber. P. 13464, TAD A.4.01 / Cowley 21, Elephantine; Darius year 5, conventionally 419 BCE
imperial_aramaic.locator: recto line 01, unbracketed form rendered your brother immediately before personal name
imperial_aramaic.source_note: The opening address of this same line is partly restored. Selected a later unbracketed word in Moore's transcription. Museum direct request returned 500; museum ID corroborated by indexed record.

comparison: Both editions recognize an initial aleph. Modern square-script rendering and scholarly transliteration describe a letter identification, not a date-specific observed phone. Both witnesses are written documents; neither measures attack, pitch, phase, timbre or sonic intention. Different genres (supplies vs festival letter); do not infer identical vocal performance. No blind evidence: both inscriptions were selected after searching for aleph.
